intro: Eve turns your dining into moments of ease and warmth. With cushioned comfort, a supportive back, and a sturdy base with optional swivel, it adapts to you, whether you stay still or move freely.

features.title: Plush cushioning for all-day comfort
features.text: Soft padding relieves pressure points, letting you sit through long family dinners or lingering conversations without discomfort or fatigue.

features.title: Curved backrest that supports posture
features.text: The gentle curve hugs your spine, encouraging upright sitting while keeping you relaxed, so you enjoy meals without strain.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Stay steady with fixed legs or choose swivel for fluid motion, giving you flexibility to dine the way you prefer.

features.title: Toffee tone that enriches your dining space
features.text: The warm brown finish adds depth and elegance, pairing beautifully with modern minimalism or traditional charm.
